# Security Policy

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SECURITY.vi.md)

Security maintenance focuses on the current public v1.0.x line.

Do not open a public issue for vulnerabilities involving credentials, unauthorized access, unsafe file handling or external-exposure authentication. Report them privately to:

`Đăng Khoa <i.am@dangkhoa.dev>`

The normal API path is local-only. Optional external exposure is a temporary authenticated demonstration surface and is not presented as a hardened multi-tenant Internet service.
